title: RBI Penalty Orders Against Bank of Baroda and GIC Housing Finance for Fair Practices Code and KYC Violations
description: <cite index="35-4,35-5">Bank of Baroda was fined Rs. 63.6 lakh for non-compliance with provisions of the Fair Practices Code for Lenders and Know Your Customer (KYC) guidelines.</cite> <cite index="35-7">The regulator found that the public sector lender had charged interest above the contracted rate in certain loan accounts.</cite>
